note: Gunnison NF (Gunnison Ranger District) campground at Spring Creek Reservoir, ~9,990 ft, about 12 mi up graded gravel Spring Creek Road (FR 744) from County Road 742 north of Almont. A boat ramp and fishing site are in the campground; the area's trails and 4WD roads draw mountain bikers, hikers and OHV riders. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov: confirmed 16 sites, $14, first-come only, vault toilets, no water. Added season 05-23..10-01 (FS), vehicle/day-use fees, Scan and Pay note. Hookups and lengths not stated by FS or rec.gov (no catalog sites). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Missing phone: Gunnison Ranger District 970-641-0471 (the FS page carries no office block; GMUG's conditions page says 'Please contact the Gunnison Ranger District front office for road condition updates at 970-641-0471'). recreation.gov facility phone 'N/A'.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront) - contrary claim, re-audit lead (not changed): FS 'Mosca Campground is located on the banks of Spring Creek Reservoir. A boat ramp and fishing site are located within the campground.' recreation.gov has no per-site coordinates (one placeholder site). Esri imagery is winter/snow-covered and shows no loops; the stored pin (and the FS point 38.859166,-106.710148, ~110 m SW of it) lies in conifer forest roughly 150 m south of the reservoir's south shore, just west of the dam, so sites nearer the west part of the south shore (where the forest meets the water, west of the dam) could be on the bank while anything below the dam has no lake value. Needs summer imagery or a site map at full pool.

Road: FR 744 (Spring Creek Road) - the FS page gives only directions ('Turn left on FDR 744 (Spring Creek Road) and drive 12 miles') with no surface, RV or 4WD wording; GMUG's alerts list no order on FR 744 or the Spring Creek area, and its conditions page sends Gunnison RD road questions to 970-641-0471. The FS page's '4WD enthusiasts' line refers to the area's roads, not the access.
Length: no stated maximum on the FS page or recreation.gov; none stored. The inclusion evidence's '35 ft max RV' is not on the current FS page.
Status: FS banner 'Site Closed' is the season end (Oct 1). No closure order found.
